title: Gimbal UFO - A New Analysis
summary: Mick West analyzes the Navy's Gimbal UFO video and gives four checkable observations suggesting it is an infrared glare that appears to rotate because the camera rotates while tracking. He argues the object is likely a hot craft hidden behind the glare.
why: Pointed to as the clearest, evidence-based debunk of the Gimbal footage, and a model of how to analyze such claims.

quote.text: The summary video is concise and only 20 minutes long. I challenge you to watch all of it and respond specifically.
